name: The Assistant's Turnabout
source:
Play as rookie attorney June Rye, tasked with defending the impossible.

Phoenix Wright has just lost his badge due to a forgery charge. During his time in prison, he schedules a meeting with Redd White, to which Redd White is found dead in a locked room. Phoenix is the only possible suspect, yet he claims Maya Fey killed him.

[From [url=https://www.igdb.com/games/the-assistants-turnabout]IGDB[/url]]
translation:
扮演初出茅庐的新人律师琼·赖伊，接手一桩看似根本不可能打赢的辩护委托。

成步堂龙一刚刚因伪造证据的指控被吊销了律师徽章。服刑入狱期间，他约见了小中大，谁知小中大随后竟被发现死在一间密室之中。成步堂成了唯一可能的嫌疑人，可他却坚称杀害小中大的真凶是绫里真宵。

[摘自[url=https://www.igdb.com/games/the-assistants-turnabout]IGDB[/url]]
